definition_en: enough in amount or quality for what is needed

examples.supportive: The small room was adequate for one guest, not for a family.

items: We did not have ____ time to finish the whole test.
The old bridge is no longer ____ for heavy trucks.
One cup of water is not ____ for a long walk.
he_interference_note: «מספיק» בעברית משמש גם כתואר וגם כתואר הפועל, ולכן דובר עברית כותב It was adequate enough — כפילות שאינה קיימת באנגלית.

definition_en: to expect something to happen and get ready for it

examples.supportive: Good drivers anticipate danger and slow down before the corner.

items: The team did not ____ so many problems at once.
A good teacher can ____ which question will be hard.
Farmers must ____ dry weather and save water.
he_interference_note: «לצפות» בעברית הוא גם to watch וגם to expect, ולכן דובר עברית כותב I anticipate television במקום I watch television.

definition_en: a judgement about how good or serious something is

examples.supportive: The doctor made a careful assessment of the injury before treatment.

items: The teacher wrote a short ____ of every student.
Our first ____ of the damage was too low.
The bank needs a careful ____ of the risk.
he_interference_note: «הערכה» בעברית מכסה assessment, estimate ו-appreciation כאחד; דובר עברית כותב I have great assessment for you במקום appreciation.

definition_en: something you accept as true without proof

examples.supportive: His plan rests on the assumption that prices will not rise.

items: We started with the ____ that everyone could swim.
Her whole argument rests on one ____.
Do not make any ____ about a person you never met.
he_interference_note: «הנחה» בעברית היא גם assumption וגם discount, ולכן דובר עברית שואל for an assumption on the price במקום discount.

definition_en: the power or skill to do something

examples.supportive: The small engine has the capability to lift heavy stone.

items: The new machine has the ____ to cut metal.
Nobody doubted her ____ to lead the team.
The old radio had no ____ to record sound.
he_interference_note: «יכולת» מתורגמת גם ל-ability וגם ל-capability, ודובר עברית משתמש ב-capability גם על אדם בהקשר יומיומי, שם האנגלית מעדיפה ability.

definition_en: a fact or condition that affects a situation

examples.supportive: In normal circumstances the shop opens early, but today is different.

items: Under no ____ should you open that door.
The judge listened to every ____ of the crime.
In this ____ we must wait.
he_interference_note: בעברית «נסיבות» כמעט תמיד ברבים, ולכן דובר עברית כותב the circumstance was hard במקום the circumstances were hard.

definition_en: the state of having many connected parts that are hard to understand

examples.supportive: The complexity of the machine surprised even the engineer who built it.

items: The ____ of the law makes it hard to follow.
Nobody expected such ____ in a simple game.
We must reduce the ____ of these rules.

definition_en: one of the parts that together form a whole

examples.supportive: Every component of the engine must be clean before the test.

items: Salt is the main ____ of sea water.
One small ____ broke and the whole machine stopped.
The report lists every ____ of the plan.

definition_en: including everything that is needed; complete

examples.supportive: The doctor gave the child a comprehensive test, from head to foot.

items: The report gives a ____ picture of every school in the city.
She has a ____ knowledge of the whole system.
The city needs a ____ plan that covers all of these problems.

definition_en: always behaving or happening in the same way

examples.supportive: Her marks were consistent all year, never higher and never lower.

items: A good runner keeps a ____ speed over the whole race.
His story was not ____ with what the guard saw.
The company wants ____ quality in every shop.

definition_en: happening all the time or staying the same

examples.supportive: The constant noise from the road kept the baby crying all night.

items: The engine needs a ____ supply of oil.
The room is kept at a ____ heat.
Their ____ demands wore the manager down.
he_interference_note: «קבוע» בעברית הוא גם constant וגם permanent וגם fixed; דובר עברית כותב a constant job במקום a permanent job.

definition_en: words that say what is wrong with someone or something

examples.supportive: The young writer could not accept criticism of his first book.

items: He cannot take ____ without getting angry.
The newspaper printed sharp ____ of the new law.
There was some ____ of the way she handled the money.
he_interference_note: «ביקורת» בעברית היא גם criticism וגם audit וגם review; דובר עברית כותב the bank made a criticism במקום an audit.

definition_en: to notice or find something that is hard to see

examples.supportive: Dogs can detect smoke long before people smell it.
examples.neutral: The machine will detect the fault.

items: This test can ____ the illness at an early stage.
She could ____ fear in his voice.
The guard failed to ____ the man behind the wall.
he_interference_note: «לגלות» בעברית הוא גם to detect, גם to discover וגם to reveal; דובר עברית כותב he detected the secret במקום he revealed the secret.

definition_en: to give your time or energy fully to something

examples.supportive: She decided to devote her free hours to helping sick children.
examples.neutral: They devote much money to it.

items: You must ____ more time to practice if you want to win.
The company will ____ half its profit to the school.
She chose to ____ her life to medicine.
he_interference_note: «להקדיש» בעברית הוא גם to devote וגם to dedicate; דובר עברית כותב he devoted the book to his mother במקום dedicated.

definition_en: to have control or the strongest position in something

examples.supportive: One tall building dominates the whole street and hides the sun.

items: A few large firms ____ the market for oil.
Do not let one voice ____ the meeting.
Tall trees ____ the north side of the park.
he_interference_note: «לשלוט» בעברית הוא גם to control, גם to rule וגם to dominate; דובר עברית כותב I dominate English במקום I have a good command of English.

definition_en: to make something better or stronger

examples.supportive: A little salt can enhance the taste of simple food.

items: Good light will ____ the beauty of the room.
Regular practice can ____ your memory.
The new engine will ____ the speed of the boat.
he_interference_note: «לשפר» בעברית מכסה improve, enhance ו-upgrade; דובר עברית כותב I want to enhance my English במקום improve.

definition_en: to judge the value or quality of something after careful thought

examples.supportive: The judges will evaluate each painting before they choose a winner.

items: The doctor will ____ how well the new drug works.
It is hard to ____ art without training.
The board met to ____ the results of the year.
he_interference_note: «להעריך» מכסה evaluate, assess, estimate ו-appreciate; דובר עברית כותב I evaluate your help במקום I appreciate your help.

definition_en: to change slowly into a different or better form

examples.supportive: Language evolves slowly, and each generation changes a few words.

items: Small shops can ____ into large companies over many years.
Our ideas about health ____ with every new study.
The city will ____ as more people arrive.
he_interference_note: «להתפתח» הוא גם to develop וגם to evolve; דובר עברית כותב the child evolves quickly במקום develops.

definition_en: someone or something that does not follow the general rule

examples.supportive: Every student must wear the uniform; there is no exception.

items: The rule holds for all, with one small ____.
Most birds fly, but this one is an ____.
The manager made an ____ and let him enter.

definition_en: to leave someone or something out of a group or list

examples.supportive: The price of the ticket excludes food and drink.

items: The club should not ____ anyone because of age.
Please ____ these old numbers from the report.
The new rule will ____ students under a certain age.
he_interference_note: אין באנגלית פועל יחיד שהוא ההיפוך של to include, ולכן דובר עברית כותב not include במקום exclude גם בטקסט רשמי.

definition_en: the act of becoming larger or of covering more area

examples.supportive: The expansion of the city ate up the fields around it.

items: Heat causes the ____ of metal.
The company planned a slow ____ into new markets.
Nobody expected such rapid ____ of the forest fire.

definition_en: a strong belief that something will happen

examples.supportive: She came with high expectations, but the show was poor.

items: The team went in with no ____ of winning.
His ____ that prices would fall proved wrong.
There is a general ____ that the law will pass.
he_interference_note: «ציפייה» בעברית היא גם expectation וגם waiting; דובר עברית כותב the expectation at the doctor was long במקום the wait.

definition_en: covering a large area or including many things

examples.supportive: The fire caused extensive damage to the whole north wing.

items: The garden needs ____ work before the summer.
He has ____ knowledge of old cars.
The report covered ____ ground in a short time.

definition_en: on or coming from the outside

examples.supportive: The external walls of the house need paint before winter.

items: The doctor found no ____ injury on the child.
The company hired a new ____ team to check the books.
The machine takes its power from a ____ supply.

definition_en: forming the base of something; most important

examples.supportive: Trust is fundamental to any friendship that lasts.

items: Reading is a ____ skill for every other subject.
There is a ____ difference between these plans.
The building has a ____ fault in its base.
he_interference_note: «יסודי» בעברית הוא גם fundamental וגם thorough וגם elementary; דובר עברית כותב a fundamental school במקום a primary school.

definition_en: real and exactly what it appears to be

examples.supportive: Experts checked the old painting and said it was genuine.

items: The old coin turned out to be ____ after all.
The shop sells only ____ parts for these cars.
Was that a ____ letter or a copy?
he_interference_note: «אמיתי» מכסה real, true ו-genuine; דובר עברית כותב a genuine story במקום a true story.

definition_en: to make something clear by giving an example

examples.supportive: Let me illustrate the problem with a simple story.

items: These numbers ____ how fast the city has grown.
The teacher used a picture to ____ her point.
This case will ____ what happens when nobody checks.
he_interference_note: בעברית «להמחיש» ו«לאייר» הן מילים שונות, ובאנגלית שתיהן illustrate; דובר עברית מניח ש-illustrate נוגע רק לציור.

definition_en: a possible result or effect of an action

examples.supportive: Nobody thought about the implications of closing the only bridge.

items: The new tax has serious ____ for small shops.
He did not see the ____ of his own words.
What are the ____ of this plan for our jobs?
he_interference_note: «השלכה» בעברית היא גם implication וגם throwing; דובר עברית מתרגם מילולית ומגיע ל-throwing במקום implication.

definition_en: to suggest something without saying it directly

examples.supportive: His long silence seemed to imply that he did not agree.

items: Are you trying to ____ that I took the money?
The report seems to ____ that the guard made a mistake.
I did not mean to ____ any blame.
he_interference_note: «לרמוז» בעברית משמש גם למי שמוסר את המסר וגם למי שקולט אותו; באנגלית imply הוא המוסר ו-infer הוא הקולט, ודובר עברית מחליף ביניהם.

definition_en: something that makes you want to do something

examples.supportive: The extra pay was a strong incentive to work at night.

items: Lower taxes give firms an ____ to hire more workers.
There is little ____ to save when prices rise.
The prize acted as an ____ for the whole class.

definition_en: the ability to decide and act on your own

examples.supportive: She showed real initiative and fixed the problem without being asked.

items: The job needs someone with ____ and energy.
He took the ____ and called the doctor himself.
Young workers here are given room for ____.

definition_en: the introduction of new ideas or methods

examples.supportive: The company grew because it welcomed innovation at every level.

items: This factory is famous for ____ in design.
Without ____ a firm will slowly fall behind.
The school welcomes ____ in teaching.

definition_en: to combine things so they work together as one

examples.supportive: The new software will integrate all the shop records into one file.

items: The city tried to ____ the new families into local life.
We must ____ these lists into a single record.
The plan will ____ health care with housing.
he_interference_note: «לשלב» בעברית הוא גם to integrate, גם to combine וגם to cross (לשלב ידיים); דובר עברית כותב she integrated her arms במקום crossed.

definition_en: to explain the meaning of something

examples.supportive: Judges must interpret the law, not write it.

items: It is easy to ____ silence as anger.
Different doctors ____ the same picture in different ways.
She was asked to ____ the old letter for the class.
he_interference_note: «לפרש» בעברית הוא גם to interpret וגם to translate בעל פה; דובר עברית כותב he interpreted the book to Hebrew במקום translated.

definition_en: to examine something carefully to find the truth

examples.supportive: The police will investigate how the fire started.

items: A team was sent to ____ the cause of the crash.
Scientists ____ why the fish are sick.
The bank refused to ____ the missing money.
he_interference_note: «לחקור» בעברית הוא גם to investigate, גם to research וגם to interrogate; דובר עברית כותב I investigate history במקום I research history.

definition_en: the way you see or understand something

examples.supportive: Her perception of the town changed after she lived there.

items: Public ____ of the police has slowly improved.
His ____ of danger is weaker than mine.
Light changes our ____ of size.
he_interference_note: «תפיסה» בעברית היא גם perception, גם concept וגם capture; דובר עברית כותב the perception of the thief במקום the capture.

definition_en: a particular way of thinking about something

examples.supportive: From a child's perspective, the garden looked like a forest.

items: Try to see the problem from her ____.
The book offers a fresh ____ on an old war.
My ____ changed after the accident.

definition_en: happening or existing before something else

examples.supportive: You need prior permission before you can enter the building.

items: No ____ experience is needed for this job.
The rule requires ____ notice of any change.
Her ____ illness made the doctors careful.
he_interference_note: «קודם» בעברית הוא גם prior, גם previous וגם earlier; דובר עברית כותב my prior teacher במקום my previous teacher.

definition_en: the official or usual way of doing something

examples.supportive: Follow the safety procedure exactly, even when you are in a hurry.

items: The hospital has a strict ____ for washing hands.
Changing the rules is a slow ____.
Every worker must learn the fire ____.

definition_en: a rule or condition that limits what you may do

examples.supportive: There is a restriction on water use during the dry months.

items: The city put a ____ on building near the river.
Travel ____ made the visit impossible.
There is no ____ on how much you may read.

definition_en: a material with particular qualities

examples.supportive: The bottle held a clear substance that smelled of oil.

items: A strange white ____ covered the floor.
The doctor found a dangerous ____ in the water.
Metal is a hard ____ that carries heat.
he_interference_note: «חומר» בעברית הוא גם substance, גם material וגם study material; דובר עברית כותב I studied the substance for the test במקום the material.

definition_en: to keep something going or alive over a period of time

examples.supportive: The soil is too poor to sustain crops for many years.

items: Little water was left to ____ the animals.
The country cannot ____ such high spending.
Air and light ____ every green plant.

definition_en: to agree to do a piece of work and start it

examples.supportive: The company agreed to undertake the repair of the old bridge.

items: Few firms are willing to ____ such dangerous work.
The school will ____ a full review of its rules.
Who will ____ the task of cleaning the hall?

definition_en: to strongly advise someone to do something

examples.supportive: Doctors urge parents to keep small children away from hot water.

items: I would ____ you to read the letter again.
Teachers ____ students to ask questions.
The leader will ____ people to save water.

definition_en: belonging to the present time; modern

examples.supportive: The museum shows contemporary art beside work that is very old.

items: This gallery only shows ____ work.
The book studies ____ family life in the city.
The design looks ____ although it is old.
